sources.title: Government Approved Test Centre rules/context

candidate_semantics: freeze equipment master identity at use time
freeze calibration certificate attachment identity/hash/object version when supplied
retain calibration date/due-date/class/reference metadata
do not infer calibration acceptability from stored facts
blockers: exact admissible equipment/calibration criteria pending independent verification

SRC-R76-2-2007-E: environment fields in applicable test-report forms

candidate_semantics: environment row must contain at least one actual measured quantity
temperature, relative humidity and barometric pressure may be captured
measurement time and optional phase are retained
captured environment is ordered deterministically in evaluation snapshots
blockers: test-specific mandatory environmental fields and tolerances remain rule-dependent

candidate_semantics: retests create new runs linked to the original run
retest reason is mandatory at the API contract boundary
authoritative run selection is explicit and append-only audited
selection requires the verified RETEST_SELECTION policy
source changes invalidate current results and reviewed state
blockers: regulatory retest triggers/selection criteria remain REG-16 pending
candidate RETEST_SELECTION cannot become authoritative without verification

candidate_semantics: published evidence carries storage identity, object version and SHA-256
evidence linked to immutable regulatory records is protected from unsafe mutation
approval snapshots include active evidence links and attachment identities
evidence changes invalidate reviewed regulatory content
blockers: which evidence is legally mandatory for each procedure remains independently unverified
retention duration and disposal authority belong to REG-17/national mapping

candidate_semantics: one canonical frozen report context drives PDF and DOCX generation
all 17 sections are represented in report context/output
unofficial preview remains numberless and visibly unofficial
blockers: local authority acceptance of generated format remains REG-17 pending

candidate_semantics: generation creates an UNISSUED report and READY generation/files
issue is a separate authenticated operation
official generation requires APPROVED + COMPLETE + determined compliance
official generation uses the current immutable approval snapshot
issue requires the explicit REG-17 authority gate
blockers: authority-specific issue conventions remain independent-expert pending

candidate_semantics: report number is server-generated
revision number and supersession lineage are explicit
issued/superseded history is preserved
report/generation/file hashes bind frozen output identity
blockers: R76-YYYY-N numbering is a project convention, not yet an accepted authority convention
exact national revision/numbering rules remain REG-17 pending

reg17.runtime_owner: AuthorizationService / ReportService / approval snapshot actor-role capture
candidate_semantics: intended issuer must have report:issue authority in the laboratory
authenticated issuer must match the frozen generation context
actor and role-assignment history is preserved in approval snapshot
blockers: which statutory officer may sign/issue remains national mapping pending
electronic/digital signature form is not asserted as legally sufficient

reg17.runtime_owner: append-only review/report history + immutable evidence objects
candidate_semantics: approval snapshots are immutable
report generations/files preserve historical identity
issued/superseded report lineage is retained
published regulatory evidence is protected from unsafe deletion
blockers: statutory retention period is not yet verified
